name: Sustainable Transportation Planning and Design
description: Introduction to sustainable transportation systems; UN SDG goals relating to transportation; sustainable transportation considering walking, cycling, public transport and emerging mobility concepts; design concepts of sustainable transportation infrastructure; land use planning for sustainable transportation; transit oriented development; environmental impact assessment for transportation projects; indicators for sustainability in transportation; alternative fuel vehicles; planning for alternative fuel vehicles; infrastructure design for alternative fuel vehicles; adoption and diffusion of alternative fuel vehicles; life cycle analysis of alternative fuel vehicles; national and international case studies.
